name: Your Pantry Just Got a Lot More Interesting: The Urban Hearth Retail Collection
excerpt: Chef Erin Miller's handcrafted pantry provisions, seasonal preserves, specialty condiments, prepared foods, and bottled cocktails are here. Order online or in store, with pickup beginning Tuesday, November 17 at our Inman Square location.

body.text: Today, we're opening the doors to a whole new way to experience Urban Hearth, from your own kitchen.

Chef Erin Miller has created a collection of handcrafted pantry provisions, seasonal preserves, specialty condiments, prepared foods, and bottled cocktails, all made with the same spirit of curiosity, seasonality, and thoughtful sourcing that guides our restaurant.

Think wild-foraged spices, house-made shrubs, preserves, holiday-ready cocktails, and of course our signature ready-to-bake biscuits to add a little Urban Hearth magic to your home kitchen this season.
A Few Things We're Excited About
For the curious cook
Our Forager's Blend Spice is a collaboration with Curio Spice Co., combining wild autumn olive, sumac, mushrooms, rose, seaweed, chili, juniper and more.
For the pantry
Stock up on crabapple jelly, sour orange marmalade, blueberry mostarda, pickled mustard seeds, candied mushrooms, spiced apple butter and more.
For the home bartender
Take home an Apple Bourbon Punch, Glühwein, or Aged Eggnog, thoughtfully crafted seasonal cocktails ready to pour, share, and enjoy.
For the breakfast table
Our beloved buttery, flaky laminated buttermilk biscuits are now available frozen, in two- or six-packs. Just bake using our fail-proof instructions and add our delicious smoked maple miso butter.
And Just in Time for the Holidays…

We're also offering a special Holiday Collection featuring everything you need to make entertaining a little easier, including turkey brine kits, turkey gravy, mushroom gravy, beet-cured salmon gravlax, duck liver mousse, cranberry sauce, and more.
Note: Items purchased from the Holiday Collection are available for pickup on Tuesday, November 24 and Wednesday, November 25.
Ordering and Pickup

Our retail collection is available to order online or in store. Regular pantry products and bottled cocktails are available for pickup beginning Tuesday, November 17, Tuesday through Saturday from 1–9 PM at our Inman Square location. Delivery is not currently available.

Whether you're treating yourself, stocking your pantry, planning a holiday gathering, or looking for a gift for the food lover in your life, we're excited to share a little more of Urban Hearth with you, wherever you're eating.
From our kitchen to yours.
— Urban Hearth
